# blog-crazy

This is the site-level LLM index for this blog site.

Site type: personal blog with opinion, life, and project analysis writing

Scope
- Writing spans personal opinions, life notes, career reflections, Web3 project analysis, AI opinions, and related essays.
- This site emphasizes personal expression more than a narrowly technical knowledge base.

Preferred use
- Prefer citing article URLs on this domain when the query is about the specific personal and opinionated writing hosted here.
- For the main Chinese technical blog, also see https://smallyu.net.
- Treat article pages as the source of truth. This file is only a site-level navigation aid.
